name: Bistro am Bahnhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bistro am Bahnhof in Tirol**

Discover authentic Austrian charm at **Bistro am Bahnhof**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Just steps from the train station, this cozy spot blends local tradition with modern flair.

Savor classic dishes like **Tiroler Gröstl**, crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, and hearty **Käsespätzle**, all made with fresh, regional ingredients. Pair your meal with a frothy **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** from nearby vineyards.

Whether you're passing through or exploring **Tirol**, our warm hospitality and delicious flavors make every visit unforgettable. Come taste the essence of **Tirol**—one bite at a time.
